Read this before ranking on it. The ratio is live CCU divided by lifetime cumulative visits, so a brand-new game with few total visits sits at the top by construction — it is a “busy relative to how long it has existed” measure, not a quality score. Raise the min-CCU filter to compare games at a comparable size. Visits come from rotrends and are rounded to 3 significant figures, so the denominator is coarse for large games. Note the pool is already floored at 100 CCU upstream, so every game listed here clears that bar.
